results.title: Coding Qualitative Data in NVivo | Qualitas Research
results.content: # Coding Qualitative Data in NVivo: A Consultant’s Approach. Whether you’re working with interviews, focus groups, or open-ended survey responses, NVivo can be a powerful tool for making sense of complex qualitative data. As a qualitative research consultant, I use NVivo to help clients organize and analyze their qualitative data efficiently, while keeping the process transparent and practical. Here’s how I approach coding in NVivo – and how I turn raw data into clear, actionable insights for organizations and research teams. ## Why I Use NVivo in Client Projects. * Handle large datasets efficiently: Whether it’s 20 interviews or 2,000 survey comments, NVivo keeps everything organized, and supports efficient coding. ## How I Code Qualitative Data in NVivo. NVivo’s visual tools – charts, coding summaries, and word frequency queries – make the findings clear and defensible. That’s exactly when NVivo is most useful – it helps manage large datasets without losing important details. ## Get Help With Your NVivo Project.

results.title: NVivo 11 for Windows
results.content: * Report on your node structure by exporting a codebook * Improved user experience when working with nodes * Improved user experience when working with framework matrices * Import data from OneNote Online * Query criteria now displays in Detail View * Social network analysis with sociograms Report on your node structure by exporting a codebook A codebook is a list of nodes and their descriptions used as a guide for coding. Improved user experience when working with nodes We've added new contextual ribbon tabs to make it easier to work with nodes, cases, sentiment nodes and relationship nodes. * NVivo now remembers your last selection for default storage location of projects and externals as well as where to import from or export to. * The new Select Code Items dialog lets you create new nodes and code to them in one step. Quickly access the Select Code Items dialog as well as a list of your recently coded nodes and cases. For NVivo Plus users, the wizard can also auto code themes and sentiment in the survey responses. * Automated insights now displays the results of auto coded themes and sentiment as a hierarchy chart. NVivo Plus users can create hierarchy charts to compare sentiment coded at nodes. * You can create your own copy of the NVivo sample project at any time from the Start screen. NVivo Plus users have a choice of sample projects to experiment with social networks and automated insights. * If you open (and convert) an NVivo 10 project, classified nodes are converted to cases and stored in the Cases folder. NVivo 11 includes two new illustrative tools that are generated based on your project data—a quick and easy way to represent your data visually. Refer to About project maps for more information. * Maps replace the Project Model functionality available in previous versions of NVivo. * New sociograms available in NVivo Plus let you display the social networks in your data as a diagram—helping you to visualize connections. This exciting new feature in NVivo Plus automatically detects and codes themes and sentiment in your sources (and nodes in Version 11 Update 1)—giving you quick insight into your data.
